title: Ride-Sharing Loyalty Feature
background: A ride-sharing company is deciding whether to add a loyalty program to improve retention.
candidate_prompt: How would you evaluate the situation and recommend what the organization should do next?
good_answer_includes: Clarifies product objectives and target users
Prioritizes features based on value and feasibility
Considers competitive differentiation and user pain points
great_answer_includes: Uses customer evidence to support prioritization
Considers monetization, retention, and engagement impact
Defines product metrics and learning milestones
interviewer_notes: A strong candidate should use a clear product strategy structure, isolate the most important drivers, and connect the recommendation to business impact.
